_meta.description: Adds the ComplianceObligation schema (Category B of the standards model). Unlike StandardsPolicy — which RANKS competing bases of accounting (one wins) — digital-compliance obligations are ADDITIVE: every obligation that applies to an administration's jurisdiction must be met. So they are tracked one record per { jurisdiction, type, standard, status, effectiveDate } rather than ordered by precedence. Covers EU e-invoicing (EN 16931 / Peppol / ViDA + per-country mandates IT/PL/ES/FR/DE/BE), SAF-T tax-audit exports, and EU VAT — see docs/standards/digital-compliance.md. Resolution by business logic is additive (meet-all-that-apply), so there is no resolver/precedence service for this schema. A future admin surface lets operators flag applicable obligations per administration; this fragment ships the data model only.

ComplianceObligation.title: Compliance obligation
ComplianceObligation.description: An additive digital-compliance / tax-data obligation applying to an administration in a given jurisdiction (Category B). Examples: EU e-invoicing under ViDA, a per-country mandate (IT SdI, PL KSeF, ...), SAF-T export, VAT. Tracked with a status and effective date; NOT ranked (cf. StandardsPolicy, which is the precedence model for bases of accounting).

administrationId.description: Optional administration scope. Null = applies to the register default.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or 'EU' for an EU-wide obligation, or 'US'.

standard.description: The underlying standard/framework this obligation implements.

status.description: Whether this obligation currently applies to the administration.

effectiveDate.description: Date the obligation becomes (or became) mandatory for this administration.

notes.example: Mandatory for most taxpayers from 1 Apr 2026; large taxpayers from 1 Feb 2026.
